blocks.html: A Drip Campaign is an automated series of emails or messages sent to prospects or customers over a set period of time.

Drip campaigns are designed to nurture leads by delivering timely, relevant, and personalized content based on a user’s behavior or stage in the buyer journey. Rather than sending one-off messages, businesses use drip campaigns to maintain consistent engagement and guide prospects toward conversion.
Drip campaigns are typically set up using marketing automation tools and are triggered by specific actions or timelines, such as:

items.html: Reaching a particular stage in the sales funnel

blocks.html: Nurtures leads over time with minimal manual effort
Aligns messaging with the buyer journey
Each message in the sequence is strategically timed and tailored to provide value, educate the prospect, and encourage the next step.
A prospect downloads an ebook and is automatically enrolled in a drip campaign that sends follow-up emails with related content, case studies, and eventually a demo invitation.

Drip campaigns are an effective way to build relationships and move prospects through the funnel with consistent, value-driven communication. When executed well, they enhance engagement and drive higher conversions.
Nurture leads on autopilot. MarketJoy helps you design and execute high-performing drip campaigns that engage prospects and turn interest into action.
